MONTE CARLO, OVERCAST
Art direction pulled off the reference and checked against what src/track.js already paints.

Roof, shutter, iron, stucco and terrace stone are already right in the game.
Sky, sea, asphalt and plaza paving are not — see the red lines on the palette board.

Reading order:
1 · the scene as six planes
2 · the palette, with repo constants
3 · the townhouse, dimensioned
4 · the parts the frame is furnished with
